CustomField.description: Set by Lead_BeforeSave_QueueAssignment when an internal (Standard) user creates the lead (manual/CSV intake). Locks the lead from auto owner/queue routing on later edits. Web-to-lead (Guest) and integration users are not flagged, so they still route.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: System-managed. TRUE = created manually/CSV by an internal user; auto-routing skipped.
CustomField.label: Manual Assignment
